ops.text: 9.4 Notwithstanding Section 2.1, Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Vendor, without penalty or early-termination fee, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or an Order Form for convenience during a term.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a Customer right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, as our playbook requires for any term longer than 12 months; Section 9 currently offers only for-cause exits and Section 2.1 negates termination rights across a three-year commitment. If helpful, we can discuss 60 days' notice as a fallback.
input.summary: Insert Customer termination-for-convenience right (30 days' notice, pro-rata refund) and confirm Vendor has no convenience right during a term.
